Teach Year-2 physics students to interpret a derivative as a physical rate, estimate vertical velocity with a forward difference, compare supplied step sizes, validate against an analytic derivative, state a simple error with units, and distinguish Core work from Working exposure.

Central difference and the error curve are Working exposure only.",
